title: Relational rule data
description: Global, tuning-agnostic rule data under /kb/rules. The engine computes facts from a card's pitch model and JOINS to these rules by computed keys (no stored card<->rule pointers; see ADR 0002). Three rule files share this schema via the `set` discriminator.

set.description: Which rule set this file holds.

id.description: Stable id. Tools cite this id as a trace so the grounding harness can verify it (ADR 0003).

category.description: A=frame (home/home-transposed/diatonic-function), B=frame modifications, C=frame (diatonic-function), D=drone-role, E=tension-vs-pedal; plus tension-table entries and ambiguity phrasing.

key.description: The computed facts the engine matches on (e.g. {intervalClass:1}, {droneDegree:9}, {tensionRank:'bite'}, {function:'IV'}). Open object: each rule set uses its own keys.

term.description: Canonical label (closed-vocabulary where possible), e.g. 'added 9th', 'semitone bite'.

phrase.description: Grounded baseline sentence with typed {slots}. The tool fills slots with COMPUTED values and returns this as the explanation; the LLM may rephrase but may not alter slot facts.

tension.description: Link to the 5-level graded-tension scale (ADR 0004), where applicable.

rank.description: Numeric tension rank 0..4 (reinforce..unstable). UI maps this to color/line intensity.

proximity.description: Optional modifier: true marks a literal-adjacent semitone (tightest bite) vs an octave-spread form. Refinement only; core scale is interval-class driven.
